remarks: Discover this stunning unit in the heart of SONO. This prime location epitomizes "Location, Location, Location," with easy access to Zagat-rated restaurants, vibrant nightlife, the Norwalk Waterfront, Maritime Aquarium, museums, the SONO Mall and the SONO Train Station, all just a short walk away. Plus, it's only minutes from grocery shopping. The condo complex boasts gated private parking-a rare find in SONO. Inside, the fully updated unit is move-in ready, featuring a spacious living room. The modern eat-in kitchen is equipped with ample cabinet space, and a large pantry, with room for barstool seating. The private bedroom includes an updated full bath and a spacious closet. Additional building amenities include an elevator, storage unit on the same floor, and laundry facilities. Lastly be sure to check out the rooftop deck with water views that's great for entertaining. Don't miss your chance to see this unique gem!
